Zemanta (zemanta.com), Ljubljana, Slovenia-founded company (later HQ'd in New York) that started as a blogging recommendation tool and became a native-advertising DSP (Zemanta One). Seedcamp 2007 winner. Seed money from Eden Ventures and The Accelerator Group, then Union Square Ventures added $650k in Sep 2008 (TechCrunch: $2.2M seed raised to that point from the three); $3M from USV and Eden (Nov 2010, ~$6M total); $2M from USV and Social Starts (Nov 2013). The company said it had raised $8M to date, which is used as amount_raised (Tech.eu later said 'more than $8 million'). A $1.6M Aug 2009 round appears only in trackers and is not itemised. Outbrain acquired Zemanta in Jul 2017 (undisclosed).
